items.title: Anomaly Detection in IOMT Devices
items.description: Developed anomaly detection system for Internet of Medical Things devices using VAE (Variational Autoencoder), Autoencoder, and LSTM models. The framework identifies security threats and unusual patterns in healthcare IoT environments through unsupervised learning techniques.

items.title: Github Profile Analyzer
items.description: Full-stack application for analyzing GitHub profiles and generating hirability scores for job market assessment. Provides insights into developer activity, code quality, and professional visibility.
items.tech_tags: Python, GitHub API, Data Analysis, Web Development

items.title: University Vehicle Tracking System
items.description: Real-time GPS tracking system for university vehicles enabling students to monitor location, routes, and seat availability. Features live updates, route optimization, and mobile interface.

items.title: Ecommerce Web Application
items.description: Full-stack ecommerce platform built with Django and React featuring product management, shopping cart functionality, secure payment integration, and responsive design.

items.title: Chittagong Weather Prediction Model
items.description: Machine learning-based weather forecasting system for Chittagong Division, Bangladesh using historical meteorological data. Implements time series analysis and regression models for accurate weather predictions.
items.tech_tags: Python, Time Series, ML Models, Data Science
